items.text: 上市後股價狂瀉未止 3大原因捨希音 撈阿里拼多多
items.summary_cn: 据报道，段永平相关持仓在Shein上市后股价持续下跌之际转向阿里和拼多多，显示其偏好中国互联网及电商资产。

items.author: Musk
items.text: Elon Musk Sees SpaceX Stock Rising to Crazy Levels. He Once Made Similar Predictions for TSLA Too
items.summary_cn: 据报道，Musk预计SpaceX股价未来升至极高水平，并再度作出类似Tesla的乐观估值判断，利好商业航天主题但不代表可直接交易。

items.author: Burry
items.text: Why Michael Burry Just Bought BYD Stock
items.summary_cn: 据报道，Michael Burry买入比亚迪股票，表达对中国电动车及新能源汽车产业的投资偏好。

items.author: Burry
items.text: ‘The Big Short’ Investor Michael Burry Justifies Lululemon Tax-Loss Sale: ‘I Am Not Throwing In The Towel’
items.summary_cn: 据报道，Michael Burry以税损卖出Lululemon并解释这是投资组合管理而非放弃看多，属于对LULU的实际减持动作。

items.author: Musk
items.text: Musk Loses Trillionaire Status As SpaceX And Tesla Drop Wipes Out $36 Billion
items.summary_cn: 据报道，SpaceX和Tesla股价下跌导致Musk及其他相关股东财富缩水，反映高估值科技及商业航天资产的波动风险。

items.author: Musk
items.text: Elon Musk’s growing SpaceX empire sends AT&T, Verizon and T-Mobile shares plunging
items.summary_cn: 据报道，SpaceX扩张引发AT&T、Verizon和T-Mobile股价下跌，市场担忧卫星通信服务将加剧传统电信竞争。

items.author: Burry
items.text: Fannie Mae, Freddie Mac, Hong Kong stocks Value Stocks late in a Bull Market, and Consolidating a Big Short
items.summary_cn: 据报道，Burry讨论Fannie Mae、Freddie Mac及香港股票估值，并称正在建立大额空头，体现其对高估值资产和市场风险的谨慎观点。

items.author: Musk
items.text: ‘I drive a Tesla’: After Elon Musk said he’d lose his job, Delta CEO Ed Bastian says there’s ‘no tit for tat’ as airline unveils earnings miss
items.summary_cn: 据报道，Delta CEO表示不存在与Musk相关的“针锋相对”，同时公司业绩不及预期，显示Tesla相关舆论与航空业基本面交织。

items.author: Cathie Wood
items.text: ARK Invest (Cathie Wood/木头姐) 2026-10-09 调仓：Nurix Therapeutics, Inc.(NRIX) 买入 ARKG 56,096 股（最大单只 ETF 占比 0.06%）
items.summary_cn: ARK Invest每日调仓数据显示，ARKG买入Nurix Therapeutics 56,096股，但占比仅0.06%，属于低于0.1%的常规小规模配置。

items.author: 洪灏
items.text: 【2255】海昌海洋公園控股股東涉嫌信息披露違法被中證監立案調查料不會對日常營運產生重大不利影響
items.summary_cn: 据报道，海昌海洋公园股东涉嫌信息披露违法被中国证监会立案调查，事件主要构成个股治理及监管风险。

items.author: Cathie Wood
items.text: ARK Invest (Cathie Wood/木头姐) 2026-10-09 调仓：Space Exploration Technologies Corp(SPCX) 卖出 ARKW 22,276 股（最大单只 ETF 占比 0.15%）
items.summary_cn: ARK Invest每日调仓数据显示，ARKW卖出SpaceX相关持仓22,276股，占比0.15%；SpaceX本身未上市，但该动作与kcn航天主题敞口相关。

items.author: Musk
items.text: Elon Musk says SpaceX could one day be worth vastly more than Earth's economy. Here's what that would take.
items.summary_cn: 据报道，Musk认为SpaceX未来估值可能远超全球经济体，释放出对卫星互联网及商业航天长期增长的高度乐观预期。

items.author: Musk
items.text: Musk vows affordable Starlink in India days before Ambani's record Jio IPO
items.summary_cn: 据报道，Musk承诺在印度推出更便宜的Starlink服务，或加剧当地电信竞争并利好卫星互联网渗透。

items.author: Musk
items.text: Musk Says Terrafab Plant Will ‘Make Chips Better Than Anyone’
items.summary_cn: 据报道，Musk称Terrafab工厂将生产“优于任何竞争者”的芯片，强化市场对AI及半导体制造扩张的预期。

items.author: 洪灏
items.text: 【螞蟻集團】螞蟻集團AI產品「靈光」已開啟小範圍內測 對標Meta Muse
items.summary_cn: 据报道，蚂蚁集团AI产品“灵光”已开启小范围内测，可能加快中国金融科技及AI应用的商业化进展，但蚂蚁集团未上市。

items.author: Pelosi
items.text: Will Taiwan derail Washington and Beijing’s latest reset? Analysts are sceptical
items.summary_cn: Pelosi相关报道讨论台湾是否可能影响中美关系缓和，但分析师持怀疑态度，提示台海及中美科技供应链仍是市场风险变量。

items.author: Musk
items.text: Trump awards SpaceX founder Elon Musk National Medal of Science
items.summary_cn: 据报道，Trump向SpaceX创始人Musk授予国家科学奖章，体现美国政府对SpaceX及其航天业务的支持。

items.author: Trump
items.text: Effective immediately, there is an ENERGY CEASEFIRE in the War between Russia and Ukraine. Both parties have agreed. Do not break it! Thank you for your attention to this matter. President DONALD J. TRUMP
items.summary_cn: Trump宣布俄乌战争达成能源停火，短线可能影响能源价格、欧洲市场及地缘风险资产。

items.author: 洪灏
items.text: 【外圍一周前瞻】本周聚焦9月CPI及PPI數據料油價上升帶動CPI按月升0.6% 美股季績期銀行股打頭陣
items.summary_cn: 洪灏前瞻称市场将关注美国9月CPI及PPI数据，并预计油价上涨推升CPI环比，可能影响利率预期、银行股及整体风险资产。

items.author: Trump
items.text: This is the woman who received the Nobel Peace Prize over the Great United States of America, whose Representative, ME, settled eight Wars, and many other things. I know nothing about this woman, and neither does anyone else! In fact, to the best of my knowledge, no one ever heard of her other than the fact that she, very obviously, hates Israel. I don’t know what the woman has done. I settled 8 Wars, with letters being sent from every President and Prime Minister from the countries that I helped to the Norwegian Nobel Committee, and I’m about to settle, or win, two more, Iran and, Russia/Ukra
items.summary_cn: Trump声称将处理伊朗及俄乌等战争议题，但表述缺乏具体政策安排，主要构成地缘政治与能源市场的不确定性信号。
